name: Mile High Maneuvers
source:
Picture this: You're just another college student trying to catch a flight home for break when suddenly you're the only human in an airport full of furry flyers. That wolf in the pilot uniform? He's definitely checking you out. The burly bear at security? He wants to give you a very thorough pat-down. And that horse flight attendant with the uniform leaving little to the imagination? He's clearly excited to have you aboard.

Welcome to Mile High Maneuvers, an adult RPG and dating sim where you'll navigate the friendly skies (and steamy encounters) as this new world's most unusual yet alluring flight attendant.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/overwoodstudios/mile-high-maneuvers-by-overwood-studios]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
想象一下：你只是另一位大学生，正试图搭乘航班回家休息，突然之间，你就成为了满是毛茸茸的传单的机场中唯一的人。那只穿着飞行员制服的狼？他肯定是在打探你。安检处那只魁梧的熊？他想对你进行彻底的搜身。还有那个穿着制服的马空姐？他显然很高兴你能加入。

欢迎来到Mile High Maneuvers，这是一款成人角色扮演游戏和约会模拟游戏，你将在友好的天空（和热气腾腾的遭遇）中成为这个新世界中最不寻常但又迷人的空乘人员。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/overwoodstudios/mile-high-maneuvers-by-overwood-studios]Kickstarter[/url]]
